chunks: And from him, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from Muhammad ibn Isma'il, from Salih ibn Uqbah, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) said:

Whoever recites a verse of poetry about al-Husayn (peace be upon him) and weeps and makes ten people weep, he and they will have Paradise. And whoever recites a verse about al-Husayn and weeps and makes nine people weep, he and they will have Paradise. He kept reducing [the number] until he said: Whoever recites a verse about al-Husayn and weeps, or even weeps together [with others], he will have Paradise.
ai.seo_question: What is the reward for reciting poetry about Imam Husayn that makes people cry?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Kamil al-Ziyarat* highlights the escalating spiritual merit of propagating the memory of Imam al-Husayn (a.s.) through poetry, emphasizing that the act of evoking collective grief serves as a means of salvation for both the reciter and the listeners. The gradual reduction in the required audience—from ten to nine, and finally to a solitary weeper—underscores the accessibility of this reward, affirming that even individual emotional engagement with the Karbala narrative secures Paradise. This reflects the Shia scholarly emphasis on *shama'il* (attributes) and *mawadda* (affection) as active, communal practices that preserve the legacy of the Ahl al-Bayt.

en.sayyid-mohsen-al-husayni-al-milani: 4. Muḥammad ibn Ja’far narrated to me from Muḥammad ibn Ḥusain, from Muḥammad ibn Ismā’īl, from Sāliḥ ibn ‘Uqbah, who said: Abū ‘Abdillāh (Imam Sādiq (a.s.)) said:

If one recites one verse of a poem about Ḥusain (a.s.) and cries and makes ten people cry, he and those (who cry) will be rewarded with Paradise. If one recites one verse of a poem about Ḥusain (a.s.) and cries and makes nine people cry, he and those (who cry) will be rewarded with Paradise… Imam (a.s.) kept reducing from the number and repeating the same reward until he said: If one recites one verse of a poem about Ḥusain (a.s.) and cries (or even tries to cry), he will be rewarded with Paradise.
